A detected leak closes the supply valves. Reset follows investigation and correction of the leak and drying of the sensor under the device instructions; repeated reset without finding the water source defeats the purpose of the intervention.

If the required change exceeds that range, nozzle, pressure or head-layout work may be necessary. The professional runs the zone again to check the whole sweep, including the wall-facing endpoint. Excessive adjustment that damages the mechanism is not a source correction.

Sensitive passages may need a different approach or retention of some varnish. Cleaning stops before pursuit of an evenly bright appearance damages original paint. This is specialist conservation of an eligible coating, not an owner-applied solvent wash or a general method for every smoke-affected artwork.

sections.title: Distribute the lift through controlled grout placement

The operator monitors elevations and pumping pressure. Rapid pressure rise can indicate binding; unexpected pressure loss can indicate grout escaping into an unintended path.

The provider stops and resolves those conditions rather than increasing pressure to force movement. ACI explains that grout can keep moving after the pump stops, so final pumping is ended before the measured target is overshot. Existing cracks and joints receive particular attention during movement.

sections.title: Complete the support and surface repair
paragraphs: After the approved lift and support work, the ports are filled flush using the specified repair method. The contractor checks transitions and the next flooring assembly’s moisture and preparation requirements. Grout beneath the slab does not replace cleanup or correct the original water source by itself.
